devicename.description: Specifies device name, it will be seen in Status page.

hostname.description: Specifies how device will be seen by other devices.

id.description: Configuration ID. Returned only if device is paired.

custom_name.description: Device's custom name. Returned only if device is paired.

hostname.description: Device's hostname. Returned only if device is paired.

devicename.description: Device's name, it is seen in status page. Returned only if device is paired.

firmware_version.description: Device's firmware version. Returned only if device is paired.

firmware_status.description: Device's firmware status. Returned only if device is paired and controller device has internet access.

firmware_status_str.description: Device's firmware status string. Returned only if device is paired and controller device has internet access.

firmware_download_percentage.description: Firmware's download progress in percentage. Only present if firmware upgrade was started.

latest_available_firmware.description: Device's latest available firmware version to update to.

syncing.description: Device configuration changes are currently being synchronized.

sync_retry_count.description: How many times the configuration synchronization retry was attempted.

sync_retry_max.description: How many times total the configuration synchronization retry will be attempted.

sync_next_retry.description: How many seconds until the next synchronization retry.

errors.description: Contains errors (if they exist) which happened during configuration synchronization with the device.

devman_group_id.description: The ID of the group to which the device belongs.

devman_group_name.description: The name of the group to which the device belongs.

mac.description: MAC address of the device to be paired.

custom_name.description: Device's custom name for easier management.

expiration_time.description: Expiration time in seconds. Device will need to be paired again after this time. Default is unlimited.

group.description: ID of the group to which the device will be added.

devman_device_cant_reach_error.description: Returned when device with the provided MAC can not be reached.

enum: Device is unreachable or doesn't exist.

devman_device_not_paired_error.description: Returned when device with the provided MAC is not paired.

404_siteman_device_not_paired.description: Returned when device with the provided MAC or ID is not paired.

404_siteman_device_cant_reach.description: Returned when device with the provided MAC or ID can not be reached.

events_log_query_param.name: events_log_limit
events_log_query_param.description: Limit number of events log entries returned.

exclude_fw_status_param.name: exclude_firmware_status
exclude_fw_status_param.description: If set to 1 excludes firmware status from the request. Should be used whenever possible to reduce load on the RUT FOTA server and to receive the response faster.

devman_status_data_param.name: data
devman_status_data_param.description: Can be used to select which data to request from the device. Used for faster response time if not all data is needed.
